title: Helper test fixture removal's wait leaves no trace of attempts or elapsed time
outcome: removeFixture in scripts/test-fixture-cleanup.mjs sets attempts and elapsed time on the error it reports at its budget and writes one stderr line naming the path, attempts and elapsed time when a wait succeeds, so growth in holds is visible as the review export's publish wait already is. Low from the review pair on the export wait change (delegation-3bdedc5a). Optional alongside it: whether the three bounded wait loops (test-launcher save, export publish, fixture removal) should share one helper.
acceptance: Helper test fixture removal's wait leaves no trace of attempts or elapsed time is done
